theme: Sunday: parent engagement / audience research question (poll)

09:00.headline: Where is he in recruiting?
09:00.topic: Audience poll: which recruiting stage the family is in (getting started, testing numbers, emailing coaches, visiting schools)
09:00.caption:
Where is your family in the recruiting process right now?

Every family starts at a different point, and there's no single right timeline.

A) Just getting started
B) Testing his numbers
C) Emailing coaches
D) Visiting schools

Wherever you are, the next step usually gets clearer once you know where his numbers fit. Exit velo, 60 time, velocity, pop time and grades all help point him toward the levels where he has real options.

Reply with your letter 👇 Your answers help shape what we cover next.

See what the numbers say about your player's best fit:

13:00.headline: Close to home or best fit?
13:00.topic: Parent debate: a school close to home vs. the level his numbers fit best
13:00.caption:
Close to home, or the best baseball fit?

It's one of the biggest conversations families have, and both sides have a point.

A) A school close to home
✅ Easier for you to see him play
✅ Familiar area, support nearby

B) His best-fit level
✅ A program where his numbers fit typical ranges
✅ A better chance to compete for innings and keep developing

Sometimes those overlap. Often they don't. Knowing which levels fit his numbers shows you whether a nearby school is a realistic match, or whether widening the map gives him more options.

Which matters more to your family? Reply A or B 👇
